subject.title: fix(codex-native): interrupt live Codex subagent thread on tasks cancel

question: Should OpenClaw support a public plugin-SDK hook for live childless-task cancellation, and if so what generic ownership, registration lifecycle, and compatibility contract should it have?
rationale: The proposed export is a new public plugin API rather than a local bug repair, and the PR acknowledges that it exceeds the current SDK callable-export budget; maintainers must choose the durable API boundary before a mechanical implementation can be accepted.

options.title: Approve a generic lifecycle-owned SDK seam
options.body: Define and document a generic live-task cancellation registration contract, including activation/replacement lifecycle and compatibility coverage, then adapt this PR to that approved API.

options.title: Keep cancellation owner-local
options.body: Avoid adding the public Codex-specific export and route the live cancellation control through an existing approved owner/runtime boundary.

options.title: Defer public API expansion
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers choose a broader childless-task cancellation API direction.

recommendation.title: Keep cancellation owner-local
recommendation.body: Avoid adding the public Codex-specific export and route the live cancellation control through an existing approved owner/runtime boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The available related-item trail ties this person to the adjacent Codex-native childless-task lifecycle behavior, although ownership of a new SDK contract remains uncertain.
